stem_book: Which of the following has been arranged in order of decreasing dipole moment? (a) CH₃Cl > CH₃F > CH₃Br > CH₃I (b) CH₃F > CH₃Cl > CH₃Br > CH₃I (c) CH₃Cl > CH₃Br > CH₃I > CH₃F (d) CH₃F > CH₃Cl > CH₃I > CH₃Br
work: μ (D): CH₃Cl 1.87 > CH₃F 1.85 > CH₃Br 1.81 > CH₃I 1.62 (short C–F bond offsets larger charge)
